text:
catherine: quick dump — ran a heterogenous quant comparison (GPTQ vs AWQ) across Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B against three internal evals (mmlu-subset, instr-dev-lite, human-eval-mini). Notes below.

samir: timeline + infra?

catherine: kicked off yesterday on prod-sim (A100-80GB shards + a couple of V100-sim workers). ~12-16h wall time aggregated.

lee: top-line?

catherine: summary:
- Llama2-13B: GPTQ preserves fp16 accuracy best; AWQ reduces latency/cost but shows occasional token-level instability on code/instruction traces.
- Mistral-7B: AWQ gives best latency, but we observe ~1.5% MMLU drop vs fp16 when using AWQ with static per-channel scales; GPTQ stays ~0.2-0.4% off.
- Qwen-7B: both need KV-cache packing tweaks; GPTQ smaller numeric drift, AWQ lower median latency for short seqs.

jess: can you paste quick table?

catherine: CSV excerpt (model,quant,eval,metric,delta_vs_fp16,median_latency_ms,cost_idx)
```
Llama2-13B,GPTQ,MMLU,acc,-0.2,315,1.00
Llama2-13B,AWQ,MMLU,acc,-1.4,235,0.78
Mistral-7B,GPTQ,MMLU,acc,-0.3,185,0.96
Mistral-7B,AWQ,MMLU,acc,-1.5,125,0.71
Qwen-7B,GPTQ,HumanEval,pass@1,-0.7,410,1.04
Qwen-7B,AWQ,HumanEval,pass@1,-2.0,285,0.75
```

samir: cost_idx normalized to fp16 baseline?

catherine: yep. fp16 = 1.0. cost_idx = median_latency * mem_factor * batch_amp (rough proxy).

lee: why Mistral hit harder on AWQ?

catherine: suspect interaction of Mistral weight outliers and AWQ per-channel scaling. GPTQ's layer-wise reconstruction retains heavy heads better. Plan: per-layer KL + svd checks.

jess: tried hybrids (layer-split)?

catherine: quick hybrid on Llama2-13B: GPTQ for first 8 layers + AWQ tail. MMLU delta -0.5, latency 260ms. So hybrid can trade small accuracy for latency.

perf-bot: deploy-sim: 10/10 shards ok. p95 +3% under synthetic steady-state.

samir: KV-cache note for Qwen: what did you see?

catherine: AWQ 4-bit packing caused misaligned KV buffers with Qwen's 8k layout -> memcpy stalls when reusing cache. Fixes: align KV blocks to 64B, pre-warm pointers, avoid pack/unpack on hot path. After changes AWQ latency improves ~12%.

lee: any instruction-following failure modes?

catherine: instr-dev-lite: AWQ Llama showed rare stop-token truncations when beam hits aligned with quantization bins. Repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/quant-instr-repro. Also higher temp sensitivity in AWQ.

jess: recommend deploy profiles?

catherine: propose three profiles for product teams:
- latency-first: AWQ + KV-align patch, aggressive caching. Risk: ~1% reasoning regressions on complex prompts.
- quality-first: GPTQ + conservative batching + fp16 fallback for suspect prompts. Cost ~20-30% above AWQ.
- balanced: hybrid quant schedule (search for N in {4,8,12}), AB test 10% sessions, automated rollback.

samir: open tickets and deck updates?

catherine: ticket created INF-4899 for KV alignment + perf dashboard. attaching artifacts.

perf-bot: INF-4899 updated with csv and logs. :white_check_mark:

lee: follow-ups:
- run per-layer KL/svd on Mistral to validate outlier theory
- automated hybrid schedule grid + rollback thresholds
- 10k-instr regression run for AWQ after KV fixes
- canary config for Dedicated with AWQ, fallback to GPTQ

jess: assign runtime to implement KV patch and alerting.

catherine: will push per-layer diffs by EOD and tag artifacts. syncing tomorrow 10:30.

lee: thanks, nice work. :thumbsup:
